(* ---------- Classical step: factoring from an even order ---------- *)

theorem shor_factor:
  assumes n: "1 < n" and ord: "is_order n a r" and even: "even r"
    and not_minus_one: "a ^ (r div 2) mod n \<noteq> n - 1"
  shows "1 < gcd (a ^ (r div 2) - 1) n \<and> gcd (a ^ (r div 2) - 1) n < n"
proof -
  from ord have r0: "0 < r" and ar: "a ^ r mod n = 1"
    and minimal: "\<forall>k. 0 < k \<longrightarrow> k < r \<longrightarrow> a ^ k mod n \<noteq> 1"
    unfolding is_order_def by auto
  obtain s where rs: "r = s + s" and hs: "r div 2 = s"
  proof -
    from even obtain b where b: "r = 2 * b" by (auto simp: even_iff_2_dvd dvd_def)
    have "r div 2 = b" using b by simp
    moreover have "r = b + b" using b by simp
    ultimately show ?thesis using that by blast
  qed
  have s0: "0 < s" using r0 rs by linarith
  have sr: "s < r" using r0 rs by linarith
  have nm: "a ^ s mod n \<noteq> n - 1" using not_minus_one hs by simp
  have m1: "a ^ s mod n \<noteq> 1" using minimal s0 sr by blast
  have a0: "a \<noteq> 0"
  proof
    assume az: "a = 0"
    have "r \<noteq> 0" using r0 by simp
    then have "a ^ r mod n = 0" using az by (simp add: zero_power)
    with ar show False by simp
  qed
  have apos: "0 < a ^ s"
  proof -
    have "0 < a" using a0 by simp
    then show ?thesis by (rule pow_pos)
  qed
  have sq: "a ^ r = a ^ s * a ^ s" using rs by (simp add: power_add)
  \<comment> \<open>Write \<open>a^s = 1 + y\<close>, so that \<open>a^r - 1 = y (y+2)\<close>.\<close>
  obtain y where xy: "a ^ s = 1 + y"
  proof -
    have "\<exists>y. a ^ s = 1 + y" using apos by (intro exI[of _ "a ^ s - 1"]) (simp add: Nat.add_sub_of_le)
    then show ?thesis using that by blast
  qed
  have dy: "y * (y + 2) = n * (a ^ r div n)"
  proof -
    have e0: "a ^ r div n * n + a ^ r mod n = a ^ r" by (rule Nat.div_mult_mod_eq)
    have e2: "a ^ r div n * n + 1 = a ^ r" using e0 ar by linarith
    have sqy: "a ^ r = 1 + y * (y + 2)" using sq xy by (simp add: algebra_simps)
    show ?thesis using e2 sqy by linarith
  qed
  have dvd_y: "n dvd y * (y + 2)" unfolding dy by simp
  \<comment> \<open>\<open>g = gcd y n\<close> lies strictly between 1 and n.\<close>
  have gdvd: "gcd y n dvd n" by (rule gcd_dvd2)
  have gne0: "gcd y n \<noteq> 0"
  proof
    assume "gcd y n = 0"
    then have "n = 0" using gdvd by simp
    with n show False by simp
  qed
  have gle: "gcd y n \<le> n" using gdvd n by (intro dvd_imp_le) auto
  have gne_n: "gcd y n \<noteq> n"
  proof
    assume gn: "gcd y n = n"
    have "n dvd y" using gcd_dvd1[of y n] gn by simp
    then obtain k where yk: "y = n * k" by (rule dvdE)
    have "a ^ s = 1 + n * k" using xy yk by simp
    then have "a ^ s mod n = 1" using n by simp
    with m1 show False by contradiction
  qed
  have gne1: "gcd y n \<noteq> 1"
  proof
    assume g1: "gcd y n = 1"
    have cop: "coprime n y" using g1 by (simp add: coprime_iff_gcd_eq_1 gcd.commute)
    have ndy2: "n dvd y + 2" using dvd_y by (rule iffD1[OF coprime_dvd_mult_right_iff cop])
    then obtain t where t: "y + 2 = n * t" by (rule dvdE)
    have e3: "a ^ s div n * n + a ^ s mod n = a ^ s" by (rule Nat.div_mult_mod_eq)
    have eqm: "a ^ s mod n + 1 + a ^ s div n * n = n * t" using e3 xy t by linarith
    have h1: "n dvd a ^ s mod n + 1 + a ^ s div n * n" using eqm by simp
    have hq: "n dvd a ^ s div n * n" by simp
    have hn1: "n dvd a ^ s mod n + 1" using h1 by (rule iffD1[OF dvd_add_left[OF hq]])
    have mlt: "a ^ s mod n < n" using n by (intro Nat.mod_lt) simp
    have "n \<le> a ^ s mod n + 1" using hn1 by (intro dvd_imp_le) simp_all
    then have "a ^ s mod n + 1 = n" using mlt by linarith
    then have "a ^ s mod n = n - 1" by (rule Nat.eq_sub_of_add_eq)
    with nm show False by contradiction
  qed
  have gpos: "1 < gcd y n" using gne0 gne1 by simp
  have glt: "gcd y n < n" using gle gne_n by (simp add: less_le)
  have ys: "a ^ s - 1 = y" using xy by simp
  have goal: "1 < gcd (a ^ s - 1) n \<and> gcd (a ^ s - 1) n < n" using gpos glt ys by simp
  show ?thesis using goal hs by simp
